# Placement gate fixture provenance

`rc.envelope.json` is a byte copy of the original `agent-ee.envelope/1` record
`fixtures/board-envelope/rc.envelope.json` written for AGENTEE-85 on
`impl/board-envelope` at e08673c. It describes the hand-made RC fixture board
`fixtures/rc/control/rc_filter.kicad_pcb`: J1 fixed on the front at the `left`
edge, 8 mm along it and 4 mm inward, rotation 0, mated `from_top`, 0 mm
tolerance. Those mating and tolerance values are owned illustrative
assumptions, not fabricator or connector datasheet facts. Root may replace
this copy with the AGENTEE-85 fixture once both branches are integrated.
